text: It is of immense importance that the soldier, high or low, whatever rank he has, should not have to encounter in War those things which, when seen for the first time, set him in astonishment and perplexity; if he has only met with them one single time before, even by that he is half acquainted with them.
author: Carl von Clausewitz
locator: Book I, Chapter VIII, Concluding Remarks
